settings.title: Make an everyday object by hand.
settings.subtitle: CERAMICS SCHOOL
settings.description: Learn to throw, handbuild, and glaze in small studio classes.

settings.title: Find your first class
settings.subtitle: CLASSES
settings.description: Begin at the wheel, work by hand, or spend a session on glaze.

tabs.title: Wheel Basics
tabs.subtitle: 4 weekly sessions
tabs.content: Start with a cylinder, then work toward an everyday cup and a low bowl.
tabs.checklist:
Beginner friendly
Tools and studio clay included

tabs.title: Handbuilding Lab
tabs.subtitle: Single 2½-hour workshop
tabs.content: Pinch, coil, and join clay by hand, then add a simple surface texture.
tabs.checklist:
Beginner friendly
Small tray or pinch bowl

tabs.title: Glaze Practice
tabs.subtitle: Single 2-hour workshop
tabs.content: Compare glaze samples and practice layering on a bisque-fired piece.
tabs.checklist:
For returning makers
Bring a studio-approved bisque piece

settings.title: From wet clay to fired work
settings.subtitle: FIRING
settings.description: Making is only the first step. Here is what happens to your piece after class.

items.title: Dry slowly
items.description: Pieces rest on drying shelves until they are ready for the kiln.

items.title: Bisque fire
items.description: The first firing turns the dried clay into porous ceramic.

items.title: Glaze and fire again
items.description: Glaze melts onto the surface during the second firing. Collect the work after it cools.

settings.title: Studio hours
settings.subtitle: Ask the studio desk about classes and collection in person.

settings.title: Before you arrive
settings.subtitle: FAQ
settings.description: What to bring, where to start, and when to come back.

items.title: What should I wear?
items.description: Choose clothes that can get dusty and shoes that cover your toes. Tie back long hair if you are using the wheel.

items.title: Which class suits a first visit?
items.description: Start with Handbuilding Lab for a single session or Wheel Basics if you want time to repeat each throwing step.

items.title: When can I collect my work?
items.description: Ask the studio desk for the collection date at the end of class. Drying and firing times depend on the piece.

settings.title: Start with a piece you want to use.
settings.description: Pick a class by technique or session length.
